findings.message: Technical validation does not establish artistic quality.
Visible pixels touch the canvas; this alone does not prove clipping.

criteria.criterion: Requested object identity is recognizable rather than merely a valid PNG
Silhouette and dominant shapes readable at native size
Shading direction and highlight placement consistent with chosen reference
Color harmony, contrast and reference-supported hue shifting
Deliberate pixel clusters, edge treatment and suitable texture density
Recognizable style compared beside approved project references
Animation motion, flicker and first-to-last loop perceived in playback

intent.usage: AT inventory texture or block texture; selective correction of requested assets
intent.material: Thorium pink metal with preserved native reference construction and protected nonmetal regions
intent.orientation: exact native reference pose and footprint
intent.lighting: reference lighting hierarchy retained, shared pink ramp; extended contrast only for powder/raw
structure: Detailed native raw-Titanium block cluster pattern and stronger fracture-light hierarchy; no camouflage polygons.
